rows.grounds: compound of dvāra, prāsāda, and vistāra denoting the width of door and shrine
indeclinable adverb indicating division into five parts
past passive participle indicating what is declared

items.question: What fivefold measure is prescribed for the width of the door and shrine?
premises: The width of the door and shrine is the subject of specification.
A fivefold division is assigned to this width.
items.inference: The width of the door and shrine is prescribed as fivefold.
uncertainties: Whether prāsāda refers specifically to the main shrine or a broader temple structure is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: The width of the door and the shrine is proclaimed to be fivefold.
